matrix.finding: V1 correctly centralizes typed Prose, Book Evaluator, Research/Evidence and Document/Export responses under Book parent intake and forbids direct provider canonical/lifecycle writes.
V1 preserves request_id, response_id, correlation_id, idempotency_key, provider subject SHA and parent projection version/digest and rejects mismatches.
V1 correctly preserves non-success and disagreement states instead of normalizing them into success.
V1 response identity, idempotency conflict and replay rules remain compatible with the research-verified boundaries.
V1 immutable proposal families/snapshots and predecessor lineage remain correct.
V1 may queue an author decision requirement but cannot manufacture author_choice, APPROVED state or AUTHOR_DECISION objects.
V1 explicitly forbids canonical pointer/project-status/lifecycle transition writes and keeps those authorities parent-owned.
V1 already states ADMITTED does not promote a manuscript candidate or advance lifecycle status.

V1 handles rights/privacy changes and preserves prior evidence, but V2 must bind rights/privacy currentness to source objects, exported artifacts and external provenance projections as distinct identities.

V1 depends on the original parent foundation contracts but does not name the later lifecycle amendment, Book/Document ownership boundary, publication/export profile or provenance projection. The implementation contract must make those dependencies explicit.

V1 has generic capability tokens such as STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_COMPLETE and PROSE_REFINEMENT_SCOPE_COMPLETE but does not explicitly preserve structural/line/copy/proof stage context, NOT_APPLICABLE rationale, narrative-consistency regression evidence, prior-stage regression or routed upstream defects.

V1 forbids provider publication-authority claims, but it does not explicitly distinguish EXPORT_GENERATED, FORMAT_VALIDATED, POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE, EXPORT_FROZEN and PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZED or bind target-medium profile/source-to-render evidence.

V1 correctly treats Document/Export as an external provider, but V2 must explicitly prohibit Book-owned rendering/conversion/validation implementation and treat the Document System or Document-owned provider as the execution owner for reusable document mechanics.

V1 has rights/provenance concepts but no explicit W3C PROV/C2PA currentness or evidence-only rule. V2 must forbid imported provenance or credential validation from becoming canonical admission, authorship, approval or publication authority.

V1 handles parent-state, rights/privacy and provider-subject staleness. V2 must additionally stale proposals when bound manuscript/source object versions, artifact digests, target-medium profiles or provenance projections are superseded or changed.
V1 atomic parent/ledger commits remain valid, but V2 receipts must carry source-object/artifact/provenance currentness identities when those evidence classes participate in admission.

BOOK-SYSTEM-SERVICE-INTERFACE-REGISTRY-001 Document/Export operations return artifact identity/format metadata but do not yet register the research-verified target-medium validation, source-to-render integrity, accessibility, proof/correction and optional provenance-credential evidence required by the publication/provenance contracts. A versioned service-interface successor is required before Runtime V2 implementation can be qualified end-to-end.

V1 remains valid historical architecture evidence but is not the correct implementation target after the research remediation. Do not edit or relabel V1 as covering the new semantics; use BOOK-SYSTEM-INTEGRATION-PROPOSAL-RUNTIME-002.
No existing exact-SHA Book foundation PASS is transferred to a revised registry, Runtime V2 implementation or future qualifier. Every changed executable subject requires its own evidence chain.

v1_final_finding.reason: Core admission safety remains sound, but later research-verified editorial, target-medium proof, Document-System ownership, provenance and expanded staleness semantics materially exceed V1's explicit implementation contract and the registered Document/Export response surface.

release_rule: Do not implement Runtime V2 until the service interface successor registers the evidence needed by the research-verified lifecycle/publication/provenance contracts and that changed interface receives its own exact-subject qualification where required.
lifecycle_engine_compatibility_boundary: Runtime V2 may preserve editorial evidence/proposal context without claiming Lifecycle Transition Engine v1 enforces new substage semantics. If executable lifecycle gate semantics change, a separately versioned lifecycle successor remains required.
qualification_effect: NONE. This re-review is architecture/control evidence only; no runtime implementation, A-01 PASS, canonical manuscript mutation, author decision or publication authority is created.
